summary.old: Know Your Meme lists a video titled 'AI Rumpelstiltskin "Tip Toein' In My Jordans"', but the page gives no further detail on who made it or how widely it spread.
summary.new: NBC Boston reports that a clip showing an imp dancing for a frightened woman in a heap of straw, turning the straw into gold and then becoming a prince when she kisses him, was taken by many viewers for a scene from an old fantasy film, such as the 1987 musical 'Rumpelstiltskin'. It was in fact made with AI and posted in August by Tatyana Tereshchenko, who describes herself as an AI artist and filmmaker. Know Your Meme, a website that tracks internet memes, says a TikTok user paired the clip with Riff Raff's song 'Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz' and a joke about dollar-store melatonin dreams, a post that passed 900,000 views; people now swap in other characters and public figures.

old: Know Your Meme has an entry titled 'AI Rumpelstiltskin "Tip Toein' In My Jordans"'.
The page text is only an embedded tweet caption from @TheAKGuy, with a joke about a 'ham planet' and cookies.

new: The clip shows an imp-like character dancing for a woman sitting in straw; he turns the straw into gold coins and, when she kisses him, becomes a prince.
Many viewers thought it came from an old film; some pointed to the real 1987 musical 'Rumpelstiltskin'; it is AI-generated.
Original posted in August 2026 (27 August per EarlyGame) on Instagram by Tatyana Tereshchenko (Stroinaya), a self-described AI artist and filmmaker.

A TikTok user, @6aimbot9, paired it with Riff Raff's 'Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz' and the caption 'The type of dreams I be having after taking dollar store melatonin' (29 September per EarlyGame); more than 900,000 views.
Users replaced the imp with characters such as Sam and Dean Winchester, Wednesday Addams, Ronald McDonald and public figures such as Gypsy-Rose Blanchard.
Know Your Meme says it spread on X, TikTok and Instagram Reels between late September and early October 2026.
